discovery_query: polynomial ideal membership Groebner basis exact quotient ring
input_contract: IdealNormalFormRequest: ideal RationalPolynomialIdeal, polynomial RationalPolynomial, monomial_order in lex/grlex/grevlex; at most 8 variables, 64 ideal generators, 4096 terms per polynomial; exact QQ coefficients.
output_contract: IdealNormalFormResult: outcome COMPUTED/ERROR/LIMIT_EXCEEDED/TIMEOUT, optional remainder and in_ideal, and the typed request.
mathematical_scope: Exact reduction of g0+1 modulo (ac-bd-1,a) checks the omitted a=0 chart. This operation does not quantify over locally nilpotent derivations, establish an action lift, or prove a coordinate obstruction.
